text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: Option A 16.0 to 16.8 s. The medium creek shot holds the half-submerged empty white car with a wake at its right. Between 16.6 and 16.8 s the car tips: its body rotates, one end rises and a wheel shows above the water line. Horizontal travel in this interval is small and not consistent in direction.
